The early stores to (v_ptr)+8/+9 hit the same RAM as the old late ones: same ROMSEL (&84 before; compiled_call puts &84 back), ACCCON untouched by compiled_call and by the kinds, v_ptr is not changed by the kinds (all 14 generated kinds write only (&C0),Y, (&C2),Y, &C2/&C3 and PLAYER_SAVE, below the arena), and the arena bytes lie inside the MAX_BLOCK room put_on reserved (sky_room / kc_arena_lim) before drawing. The kinds do not depend on Y at entry (Y now 9, before the index): each loads Y with LDY before its first Y use (grep of the _ok labels in src/compiled_*.6502); X and A at the calls are unchanged (X = &84, or the kind in the HAZEL path). Refused path (carry set, kinds write nothing): the dirty bytes at v_ptr+8/+9 are rewritten by the generic draw_column (+8 count-1, +9/+10 the address) or by kc_draw (+8 KC_MARK, +9 slot) before restore_block can read them, and restore_block walks only to rb_end. The compiled path only runs in play (dm_slot 0, unclipped), so the front end, define controls, game over and completion screen are unaffected; the IRQ does not read the arena. Room: render.6502 shrinks by 3 bytes; tables after render_end (sprite_column_count &A366, ck_index &A3B2, ...) shift down 3, which only lowers their indexed page crossings (no base low byte at &00-&02), but the straight sprites' (col_ptr),Y page straddles also shift: the gate's speed check must cover that. Recount: STX zp 3 + LDA zp 3 - TXA 2 = 4 cycles a drawn execution; 2 + 2 - 1 = 3 bytes.
